text:
tara_support: Hey team — getting a spike of reports that Console -> Analytics charts fail to load with 500s since ~09:12 PDT. Several paying customers affected.

maria_support: Confirmed in ticket #3487 and another live chat. Customers see "Failed to load charts (500)".

liam_sre: I'm on it. Any recent deploys to analytics? pinging @ops_oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: analytics-service v2.14.7 to prod at 09:08 PDT by ci/cd-pipeline.

devon_frontend: Repro steps I used: open Console -> Organization -> Usage -> set timeframe 1h -> graphs attempt to render, then spinner -> error. Happens for multiple orgs, not just one.

liam_sre: Running a quick curl against the internal API endpoint returning chart data:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.internal/internal/analytics/v1/series?org=123&range=1h"
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{\"error\":\"panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
\tgoroutine 128 [running]:
\tgithub.com/redwood/analytics/series.Build(0x...)
\t...\"}
```

liam_sre: Logs show a lot of 500s with the above panic coming from analytics-worker handling prefix-aggregation. Also seeing DB replica lag and Redis timeouts around same time.

ops_oncall: Grafana panels: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/analytics — p95 CPU for analytics-prod-02 jumped to 98% at 09:09, Redis p95 latency to 120ms, DB replica lag ~45s. Possible cascading failures.

devon_frontend: Can confirm frontend retries make it worse (many concurrent chart requests). We should ask Console to fallback to cached data while backend recovers.

liam_sre: Mitigation plan: 1) scale analytics-workers +2, 2) restart analytics-prod-02, 3) if not resolved, rollback v2.14.7 to v2.14.6. Doing (1) now.

deploy-bot: scaling analytics-workers by +2 (requested by liam_sre).

ops_oncall: Restarted analytics-prod-02 at 09:22 PDT. Tailing logs — panic messages dropping off. Redis latency trending down.

liam_sre: After restart + scale, curl returns 200 and series payload for multiple calls. Rolling back is on-hold, but ready if we see recurrence.

devon_frontend: Charts loading again in Console for my repro cases. Customers in support chat are reporting graphs are visible. :tada:

maria_support: I updated the affected tickets with timeline, mitigation steps, and apology. Notifying account managers for customers impacted.

liam_sre: Filing incident and will add RCA after full log aggregation. Initial suspected root cause: regression in v2.14.7 that caused a nil deref in prefix aggregation under high concurrency and degraded downstream Redis/DB made recovery harder.

tara_support: Thanks all — marking as escalated and will follow up with customers with ETA for RCA.

liam_sre: We'll keep the ticket open until we confirm stability for 24h.

ops_oncall: leaving a note to revert Console retry behaviour to use cached data as a protective fallback in future.
